name: Forgetting
overview: Scripture teaches that forgetting can be both a divine act and a human challenge. God graciously chooses to forget the sins of His people, as He promises to blot out transgressions and remember iniquity no more, offering forgiveness and freedom from condemnation in Christ (Isaiah 43:25; Jeremiah 31:34; Romans 8:1). However, forgetting can also reflect spiritual failure, as God's people are admonished for forgetting Him repeatedly (Jeremiah 2:32). Believers are called to forget the past in a way that enables them to press forward in faith, focusing on what lies ahead in their walk with Christ (Philippians 3:13; Isaiah 43:18).
